title: Finite split-history to exact-Q3 Lie-Trotter convergence carrier
question: For each declared finite Q3 Hamiltonian, do both onsite-plus-bond Lie-Trotter orders and both time signs converge to the same exact full-Hamiltonian unitary at a fixed horizon, and does the associated two-orientation Volterra history converge with them?

adversarial_review.check: The exact comparison unitary is formed from the same finite Hamiltonian that is reconstructed as the sum of all onsite and bond split terms.
Both declared term orders and both time signs are compared against the same exact full-Hamiltonian unitary; no order is silently selected.
Right and left noncommuting cubic multipliers are propagated under split and exact discrete adjoint histories separately, and their difference is checked independently.
The finite grid checks decreasing errors as the declared step count grows; it does not promote the observed slope to an analytic Lie-Trotter rate.
Volumes, probes, step counts and source pairs are finite declared cases; no volume-, cutoff- or beta-uniform limit is inferred.
Finite split-to-exact agreement does not establish a common core, exhaustion-independent dynamics, OS/KMS/GNS identification, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational horizon/refinement and orientation-difference bookkeeping only; matrix exponentials, convergence and all QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: The declared finite split histories are explicitly tied to the same finite full-Q3 Hamiltonian through two-order, two-sign Lie-Trotter comparisons and two-orientation history comparisons.
qft_interface.open: An analytic Trotter rate, common operator domain, actual thermodynamic history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, source/volume/beta uniformity, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No TECT production owner, heat_root_incidence, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

no_overclaim: This finite convergence audit validates only the bridge between the declared split product and the exact finite-Q3 matrix flow. It neither proves a thermodynamic QFT dynamics nor closes C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
